DAG-based pairwise evaluation method successfully captures complex reasoning structures for optimization.

title: Holi-Spatial: Evolving Video Streams into Holistic 3D Spatial Intelligence
current_claims: Holi-Spatial-4M dataset contains 12K optimized 3DGS scenes, 1.3M 2D masks, 320K 3D bounding boxes, 320K instance captions, 1.2M 3D grounding instances, and 1.2M spatial QA pairs.

Fine-tuning Vision-Language Models on spatial reasoning tasks using this dataset leads to substantial improvements in model performance.

title: VisionWebDev: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
current_claims: VisionWebDev comprises 193 tasks across 16 categories spanning static UI-to-code generation, interactive multi-page frontend reproduction, and long-horizon full-stack website development.

title: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
current_claims: SceneSmith generates 3-6x more objects than prior methods with <2% inter-object collisions and 96% of objects remaining stable under physics simulation.

title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Assumptions, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
current_claims: DPO equivalence with RLHF is conditional on the assumption that RLHF-optimal policies prefer human-preferred responses, which is frequently violated in practice.

When the equivalence assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences, leading to policies that decrease DPO loss while preferring dispreferred responses.
CPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks while providing provable alignment guarantees.

title: ProcMEM: Learning Reusable Procedural Memory from Experience via Non-Parametric PPO for LLM Agents
current_claims: ProcMEM achieves superior reuse rates and significant performance gains with extreme memory compression.
ProcMEM enables agents to learn procedural memory from interaction experiences without parameter updates.
ProcMEM facilitates long-term autonomy through transparent accumulation, refinement, and reuse of procedural knowledge.

title: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
current_claims: PACT significantly reduces safety violations by 31.0% on average while improving task success by 30.7%

title: Protein Autoregressive Modeling via Multiscale Structure Generation

title: VideoKR: Towards Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Understanding

title: PLANTAIN: Plan-Answer Interleaved Reasoning

title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation Without Aligned Data
current_claims: Hibiki-Zero achieves state-of-the-art translation accuracy, latency, voice transfer and naturalness across five X-to-English simultaneous speech translation tasks
Accomplishes this without word-level alignments between source and target speech, using only sentence-level aligned data

title: SleepLM: Natural-Language Intelligence for Human Sleep
current_claims: SleepLM outperforms state-of-the-art in zero-shot and few-shot learning, cross-modal retrieval, and sleep captioning.
Introduces sleep-text dataset comprising over 100K hours of data from more than 10,000 individuals.

title: Stable Deep Reinforcement Learning via Isotropic Gaussian Representations
current_claims: Isotropic Gaussian embeddings improve performance under non-stationarity while reducing representation collapse and neuron dormancy
Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization is simple and computationally inexpensive method for improving training stability
Isotropic Gaussian embeddings induce stable tracking of time-varying targets and achieve maximal entropy under fixed variance budget

title: TimeRewarder: Learning Dense Reward from Passive Videos via Frame-wise Temporal Distance
current_claims: TimeRewarder achieves nearly perfect success in 9/10 Meta-World tasks with only 200,000 interactions per task.
TimeRewarder outperforms previous methods and manually designed environment dense reward on both success rate and sample efficiency.

title: Advancing LLM Reasoning with Natural Language and Numerical Feedback
current_claims: Critique-GRPO achieves average Pass@1 improvements of +15.0-21.6% on various Qwen models and +7.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct through combined natural language and numerical feedback
Critique-GRPO facilitates effective self-improvement through self-critiquing, achieving +16.7% Pass@1 improvement on AIME 2024

title: Focusing Where Vision Matters: Selective Training for Large Vision Language Models via Visual Information Gain
current_claims: Visual Information Gain (VIG) metric measures reduction in prediction uncertainty provided by visual input.
VIG-guided selective training improves visual grounding and mitigates language bias while requiring significantly reduced supervision.
The method focuses exclusively on visually informative samples and tokens to achieve superior performance.

title: MEMO: Memory-Augmented Model Context Optimization for Robust Multi-Turn Multi-Agent LLM Games
current_claims: MEMO raises mean win rate from 24.9% to 49.5% for GPT-4o-mini and from 21.7% to 44.3% for Qwen-2.5-7B using 2000 self-play games per task.
Reduces run-to-run dispersion of end-to-end outcomes and yields more reliable rankings under prompt stratification.
Achieves gains in negotiation games and imperfect-information settings while RL remains more effective in perfect-information games.

title: NanoQuant: Efficient Sub-1-bit Quantization of Large Language Models
current_claims: NanoQuant is the first post-training quantization method to compress LLMs to binary and sub-1-bit levels.
Compresses Llama2-70B by 25.8x in 13 hours on a single H100, enabling operation on consumer 8GB GPU.
Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy at sub-1-bit compression rates, establishing new Pareto frontier in low-memory quantization.

title: TimeSpot: Benchmarking Geo-Temporal Understanding in Vision–Language Models in Real-World Settings
current_claims: TimeSpot benchmark contains 1,455 ground-level images from 80 countries requiring geo-temporal reasoning
State-of-the-art VLMs show consistently low performance, particularly for temporal inference tasks
Includes spatial-temporal reasoning tasks probing physical plausibility and cue integration

title: VLM-RobustBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robustness of Vision-Language Models
current_claims: VLM-RobustBench spans 133 corrupted settings across 49 augmentation types with graded severities evaluating four VLM families
Visual severity is weak predictor of difficulty; low-severity glass_blur reduces MMBench accuracy by ~8pp while geometric distortions reach 34pp
Current VLMs are semantically strong but spatially fragile with resampling and geometric invariances key vulnerability

title: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere
current_claims: SSO consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon across diverse architectures including Dense 1.7B, MoE 8B-A1B, and 200-layer DeepNet models.
SSO enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on both weights and updates, realizing fully μP-aligned optimization.
Improved MoE router load balancing, suppressed outliers, and strictly bounded activations observed.

title: d2: Improved Techniques for Training Reasoning Diffusion Language Models
current_claims: d2 sets new state-of-the-art performance for DLMs on logical reasoning tasks (Countdown and Sudoku) and math reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K and MATH500)
d2 significantly outperforms widely-used RL baselines when applied to popular diffusion language models

title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
current_claims: LLaDA-S achieves best-of-N performance with substantially fewer function evaluations across four mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks.
Performs efficiently across three discrete diffusion language models including LLaDA 8B and Dream 7B.

title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
current_claims: Staged training achieves 1.5% higher reasoning accuracy with 20.8% shorter reasoning traces than merged training.
Staged-training models achieve +5.2% on WeMath and +3.7% on RealWorldQA compared to base counterpart.
